validation_limits: Blender CPU geometry and optional Cycles composition preview only. Not a Godot, Windows, NVIDIA or player-controller visual validation.

door.collision_strategy: Exact convex segmented annular wedges and exact spandrel wedges; never an AABB across the opening

ref5_crown_binding.scope: Vertical pearl faces of main/far walls, continuous parapet and arch spandrels only.

recommended_views.fov_derivation: atan2 extents of camera.data.view_frame(scene=scene) with actual saved render aspect; not a 16:9 assumption

diagnostic_views.target_method: Analytic reflection of actual lens centre across right wall x=2.9, intersected by the eye-to-virtual-source ray. No guessed highlight target.
diagnostic_views.meter_scale_note: Each ceramic grid cell is 0.10 m; ten cells span 1 m. Wall geometry, lights, material and exposure are unchanged.
